description: Return the full design of a template from the HyperCodeMotion Studio gallery, by its id and format: brief (palette, fonts, frame, rhythm), scenes with timings, and the composition with its HTML scene documents and layers. Use it as the design reference when asked to follow a template; it does not create or store anything.

format.description: Aspect ratio of the video being made. Defaults to 16:9.
